title: From Deliberately Constructed Systemic Representations of the World of Activity to Dialogue: A Five-Level Communication Architecture for Strong Language-Based ASI
abstract: arXiv:2610.32869v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper proposes a five-level organization of message formation and understanding within thinking and activity in which ASI participates. Its central thesis is that a language model's context is fundamentally incapable of presenting the foundations of utterance formation for examination and verification. These foundations are established in advance by acquired schemas, systemic representations of the world of activity, and connections accepted as true within them. Neither context nor trained LLM weights, in themselves, attest to the presence of deliberately constructed systemic representations. The five levels distinguish systemic representations of the world of activity, a particular situation cut out from those representations, its narrative description, the full sense of a message, and text. A situation's schema-model is not identical to a story about it. A recipient reconstructs the full sense from an abbreviated text through join

translated_title: 从刻意构建的活动世界系统表征到对话：面向强语言型ASI的五级通信架构
translated_abstract: 本文提出了在ASI所参与的思维与活动中，消息形成与理解的五级组织结构。其核心论点是：语言模型的上下文从根本上无法将话语形成的基础呈现出来以供检验和验证。这些基础是由后天习得的图式、活动世界的系统表征，以及在其中被视为真实而接受的关联所预先建立的。无论是上下文还是经过训练的LLM权重，其本身都不能证明存在刻意构建的系统表征。这五个层级区分了：活动世界的系统表征、从这些表征中切分出的特定情境、对该情境的叙述性描述、消息的完整意义，以及文本。一个情境的图式模型并不等同于关于它的故事。接受者通过拼接从缩略的文本中重构出完整意义……
tldr: 论文提出五级消息形成与理解架构，主张语言模型的上下文无法呈现话语形成的基础——这些基础由习得的图式和刻意构建的活动世界系统表征预先建立，并据此为强语言型ASI设计了从系统表征到文本的通信架构。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a five-level communication architecture for strong language-based ASI, arguing that a language model's context is fundamentally incapable of presenting the foundations of utterance formation, which are established in advance by acquired schemas and deliberately constructed systemic representations of the world of activity.
